title: Volcano Cleaning Brush
description:
The Volcano cleaning brush is made up of very hardy materials. And makes cleaning your vaporizers and herb grinders a breeze.
This brush is one of the best on the market and can be used to clean and brush away the unwanted off any of your vaporizers and parts that go with it.
